0022600100.text: Utah (0-1, 12th in the West, 5th in the Northwest and 1 games back) hosts New Orleans (0-1, 9th in the West, 3rd in the Southwest and 1 games back), with both teams still searching for their first win and the Jazz's only game so far a 0-1 road loss. Jusuf Nurkic (foot) and Trey Alexander (knee) are out for Utah, and Tony Bradley (quadriceps) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz were swept 0-3 by the Pelicans, including a 156-137 loss in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
